reason: The get_task registration shown calls n.tasks.get(...) for one or more requested IDs and returns the resulting task object(s) in the MCP response via Y(...). The wrapper also may include tag data derived from the project root/state. This establishes that the tool returns project task data from local/project storage into the agent context, so SECRET is supported. The returned task fields and even some error text include task/user-controlled content such as task data or requested IDs, so UNTRUSTED is supported. The cited lines do not show arbitrary host code execution such as eval/child_process, so HOSTEXEC is not supported. They also do not show sending agent-supplied data to an attacker-readable external destination or other sink; it only returns data to the caller/logs locally, so SINK is not supported.
